methods.independence: Standard-library SHA256, SQLite read-only queries/dumps, Python AST, arithmetic/statistics and Git committed-file reads; no repository scoring/verification functions invoked.
methods.formulas: Active=mean80 active-centroid returns/500; previous=mean3 centroid previous-task episode means/500; combined=(active+previous)/2. LA=mean4 own-phase means; F=mean3 signed consecutive differences; ZT=mean3 next-phase means. Integral=y0+successive trapezoids, multiplied by96000 for steps; sample SD across3seeds.

proposal_usage.note: Guard enforces ChatGPT authentication; launches are not backend request counts or a remaining-subscription-allowance meter

limitations: All valid-candidate selection scores are independently recomputed exactly; detailed reference metrics are recomputed for new programs. Inherited reference metrics remain bound by preserved evidence and earlier reviews.
This audit does not itself close the endpoint or authorize reserved outcomes. A separate closure decision is required.
Historical stage13 RNG rollback remains a declared deviation from uninterrupted search.
Actual backend model-request counts and subscription allowance remain unobservable.
